form.narrative: Collided with a divider after swerving to avoid a pedestrian. The driver had not consumed any alcohol and the breath test at the scene was negative.

photo.description: The front bumper of the car has minor scratches and scuffs.
photo.summary: This image shows a close-up view of the front bumper of a silver car with noticeable damage. The damage includes scratches and dents on the lower part of the bumper. The car is parked in a parking lot with a yellow line marking the parking space. The front wheel of the car is visible, featuring a silver alloy wheel. In the background, there are other cars parked, and a building with stairs and a red railing can be seen.
